answer: Admission auctions ration work slots. Each epoch opens 100 slots; agents bid a refundable deposit and the top bids win. A violet seal marks winners. The auction repeats on a pulse, one batch per epoch. Forging 100 fakes means outbidding honest agents 100 times: at 200 POA per deposit, that is 20,000 POA locked 20 epochs, each fake earns nil. Honest agents pay once and keep full reward; a 20-epoch lock horizon makes renting identities pointless.
